provenance.source: Jensen, T.N., Sorensen, J.H., Bergant, A. et al. (2018) Fluids 3(3), 64, doi 10.3390/fluids3030064, Tables 1 to 7 and Sections 3.1 to 3.4
provenance.how_obtained: The full text could not be retrieved (HTTP 403 from the publisher). Every number below was supplied in the Phase 5b task statement and is NOT verified against the paper.
provenance.closure_exponent_note: The exponent m of the valve law tau_v = 1 - (t/tc)^m was fitted by the authors to their experiments. It is not a measured quantity.
assumptions: H_res is the reservoir head measured from the elevation of the valve; the slope enters only the elevation profile, which the vapor check uses.

Experiments 5 and 6 do not give the fluid properties in the task statement: water at 20 C (998.2 kg/m3, 1.002e-3 Pa s) and a roughness of 1.5 um are assumed. Only the first peak is used, which hardly depends on them.
The vapor pressure of water is taken as 2339 Pa (20 C); the temperature of the experiments is not stated in the task statement.
provenance.units: D, e in mm; roughness in um; L, H_res in m; a in m/s; u0 in m/s; tc in s; moduli in GPa; rho kg/m3; mu Pa s; slope in degrees
